notes.title: Updates & Fixes 1.0
notes.notes: [p][b]Hello fellow neighbours![/b][/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for the love and support you've shown us since the launch! We see your reviews and we want to thank you for the positive comments and feedback regarding the game. [/p][p][/p][p]We're working on some more updates, but we'd like to share some updates we've made:[/p][p][/p][p][b]RESTART LEVEL[/b][/p][p]Whether you realise you don't have enough time to reach Cheryll, or you were reading the room before playing the level -  you can now restart the level mid-round from the pause menu![/p][p][/p][p][b]SKIP LEVEL[/b][/p][p]Is a level too difficult? We've added a feature that will pop up and allow you to skip the level if you've not been successful in clearing a level too many times.[/p][p][/p][p][b]SPELLING ISSUES[/b][/p][p]There were some minor spelling issues - thank you to those who contacted us and let us know. We've fixed them~[/p][p][/p][p]If you're content creator making content or streaming our game, feel free to tag us at our socials:[/p][p][url="https://x.com/battlebrewpro"]Twitter[/url] [url="https://bsky.app/profile/battlebrewpro.bsky.social"]Bluesky[/url] [url="https://www.instagram.com/battlebrewpro/"]Instagram[/url] [url="https://www.instagram.com/battlebrewpro/"]Tiktok[/url] [url="https://www.youtube.com/@battlebrewproductions"]Youtube[/url][/p][p][/p][p]If you love sneaking around in cute games then you should give this game a shot~ For media inquiries, interview requests, or review codes, please contact: [/p][p][url="https://hello@battle-brew.com"]hello@battle-brew.com[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Hope to come back with more exciting news and updates next time soon~[/p][p][/p][p]With Love,[/p][p]BattleBrew Productions[/p]

notes.title: Release Date Announced!
notes.notes: [p][b]Hello fellow neighbours![/b][/p][p][/p][p]It has been a week since the end of Steam Next Fest Summer 2025! notes.title: Steam Next Fest Demo Released!
notes.notes:
[p][b]Hello fellow neighbours![/b][/p][p][/p][p]It's our first time saying hello, so we wanted to make this as good of a greeting as we can~
We're just popping in to let you know that we're working on the game and have some exciting news ready to announce in the future![/p][p][/p][p]Meanwhile, if you wishlisted the game previously, you would have received an email that our demo is finally up on steam! We hope you enjoy this little quickie of a demo during Steam Next Fest and share about Love in Tiny Spaces on your socials![/p][p][/p][p]We're very honoured to also be a part of the Southeast Asian Games Showcase Event on steam! There are many amazing other games from the SEA Region we think you should definitely check out! Huge thanks to the [url="https://x.com/SEAGShowcase"]@seagshowcase[/url] team and kudos to them for an amazing job~[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45281776/a4bc8805971ffb76949e5a4fbe4d0892a5d39bdb.jpg"][/img][/p][p]If you're content creator making content or streaming our game, feel free to tag us at our socials:[/p][p][url="https://x.com/battlebrewpro"]Twitter[/url] [url="https://bsky.app/profile/battlebrewpro.bsky.social"]Bluesky[/url] [url="https://www.instagram.com/battlebrewpro/"]Instagram[/url] [url="https://www.instagram.com/battlebrewpro/"]Tiktok[/url] [url="https://www.youtube.com/@battlebrewproductions"]Youtube[/url][/p][p](We'll try popping into streams if we know you're playing our game, but our in-house marketing person is slow on catching on - you'll have to excuse her tardiness)[/p][p][/p][p]While the demo should give you an idea of how Love In Tiny Spaces works, please note not everything is final in-game - artwork, balancing, mechanics and items may change before the game's release. [/p][p]There's plenty more that we're working on behind the scenes, but as you may encounter some bugs or issues in the demo, we've created a google form for you to report them! This is incredibly valuable and will help us make sure you get the best experience at launch.[/p][p][url="https://forms.gle/Pi4n4sY3pdmP3D8v8" buttoncolor="#e81760"]Love In Tiny Spaces Bug Report Form[/url][/p][p][/p][p]With Love,[/p][p]BattleBrew Productions[/p]
